message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.52, "reasons": ["The artifact is clearly structured to meet the brief but is truncated and incomplete: it ends mid-sentence in the LFP safety/thermal paragraph and lacks the full VRFB detailed sections, tradeoffs discussion, decision criteria, open questions, and the consolidated reference list.", "Missing sections: VRFB detailed summary, tradeoffs (cost, lifespan, efficiency, safety, installation), recommended decision criteria for homeowners, open questions/uncertainties, and a complete references list with links.", "File references and completeness: the artifact does not clearly present a final comparison_report.md file as a standalone deliverable (title present but no full content to the required depth)."] , "guidance": "Revise by delivering a complete comparison_report.md that: (1) includes an executive summary with recommendation and best use cases, (2) presents the side-by-side metrics table (all requested metrics present and clearly sourced), (3) provides detailed, complete sections for LFP and VRFB (with performance, costs, safety, maintenance, installation considerations), (4) discusses tradeoffs comprehensively, (5) outlines homeowner decision criteria, (6) lists open questions/uncertainties with explicit references to the meeting notes, (7) consolidates a references list with links, and (8) ensures all numbers flagged as uncertain are clearly labeled and explained. Also fix the truncated sentence in the LFP safety section, verify all numbers against the source artifacts (lfp_battery_research.md, vanadium_flow_battery_research.md, team_discussion.md), and ensure the file reads as a complete, standalone Markdown document named comparison_report.md."}
